Modes perf: \(\Delta t_{PASSIVE} < \Delta t_{FULL} < \Delta t_{TRUNCATE}\); PASSIVE ~0 block, FULL blocks readers ~log frames. [sqlite](https://sqlite.work/wal-mode-behavior-and-optimizing-checkpoints-in-sqlite/)
